testimonials.name: JOSE FRANCH
testimonials.quote: Collaborating with Vicent Egea Insa on creating new works was an unforgettable experience. Vicent made me embark on a journey of sounds and emotions I had never experienced before. All thanks to his prodigious creativity and great technical control.

testimonials.name: BEN KOPEC
testimonials.quote: Vicent is a talented composer across multiple genres. I'm always pleased with the quality of work from him. His compositions are fresh, compelling, and well balanced.

testimonials.name: HENK UMMELS
testimonials.quote: Since 2015 Maestro Vicent Egea Insa is a respected and valuable composer. Masterpieces such as his pieces for solo and band are of excellent level. In addition to being a skillful composer, Vicent is a very pleasant person to work with. Very communicative and flexible.

testimonials.name: ANDRÉS VALERO CASTELLS
testimonials.quote: Master Vicent Egea has a great talent for conducting based on a rigorous work procedure from exhaustive knowledge of the score and of the respect, interest and love for what he conducts. All this, additionally, brings the maximum energy to his concerts and becomes the desired interpreter for composers.

testimonials.name: BERNARDO ADAM FERRERO
testimonials.quote: Vicent Egea is without a doubt the type of conductor I would put my hands on any of my works with full guarantee of success. In addition to his human quality, he is very well professionally trained, which together with his experience make him a safe bet for any symphonic formation.
